correctness.rationale: For \(m,n\ge2\), the 2-token graph is connected and bipartite. Its signless Laplacian has an equitable three-cell partition with quotient [[2n,2n,0],[m-1,m+n-2,n-1],[0,2m,2m]]. The strictly positive vector (n(n-1),(m-1)(n-1),m(m-1)) is an eigenvector with eigenvalue \(2(m+n-1)\). Perron--Frobenius identifies this as the signless-Laplacian spectral radius, and bipartite similarity transfers it to the ordinary Laplacian. Boundary m=n=2 and broad finite instances were replayed by the packaged checker.
